sun-in-aries: Exalted here, the Sun is at its most forceful. The month runs on raw vitality, the kind that starts things, recovers fast and does not wait for permission. Energy goes into beginnings rather than upkeep. The heat has a shadow in fevers of temper and in projects launched hot and abandoned once the first push is spent.
sun-in-taurus: Money and appetite sit at the centre of the month. Spending runs toward dress, comfort and anything that can be shown off, and the pleasure taken in the body is open and a little vain. Voices carry well, and so do songs. The shadow is extravagance, and an attraction that moves faster than good sense.
sun-in-gemini: Attention scatters pleasantly across letters, errands, conversation and short trips. The mind is brighter for being on the move, and the month rewards anyone willing to go somewhere and talk to someone. Affability is the general tone. The cost is depth, since nothing is held long enough to finish before the next thing arrives.
sun-in-cancer: Vitality sits at its lowest ebb of the year, and the month turns inward toward home, family and the comforts that need no effort. Quarrels are avoided and the mood is agreeable so long as no one asks for hard work. Feeling runs deep and a little psychic. Reward comes late rather than early.
sun-in-leo: At home in Leo, the Sun rules the month outright. Purpose concentrates, pride is on display, and whatever is undertaken is done wholeheartedly or not at all. Loyalty runs deep and so do aversions, though honour matters more than winning and even quarrels are conducted with a certain magnanimity. The shadow is a need to be obeyed.
sun-in-virgo: Business takes a practical, sharp-eyed turn. The month favours the middleman, the clerk, the chemist and anyone who can see at once which detail will pay. Health and diet come under scrutiny, usually with a strong faith in remedies. Manners are smooth and sociable, though underneath, attention to advantage can harden into looking after number one.
sun-in-libra: The Sun is in its fall here and gives way to partnership. The month revolves around the other person, whether spouse, rival or counterpart, and little is decided alone. Taste improves, and architecture, decoration and music draw more than usual interest. The weakness is a centre that is hard to find without someone else to reflect it.
sun-in-scorpio: Energy turns intense and surgical. The month favours courage, independence and the kind of work that cuts into what others leave alone, from medicine to investigation to combat. Finances shift through what is shared or inherited. The shadow is bluntness that rides over everyone in its way, and an indifference to the pain it causes.
sun-in-sagittarius: Ideas run high and the mood is generous. Positions of trust, missions of some delicacy and matters of law, faith and statecraft all go well, since the month lends an expansive mind and an instinct to rise by raising others. Honours are handed out freely. The danger is lofty talk that never descends to the particulars.
sun-in-capricorn: Advancement comes through the goodwill of those higher up, and the month rewards whoever proves careful, prudent and faithful in a position of responsibility. Judgements cannot be bought. Fair play earns a quiet, durable respect. The weather is sober rather than warm, and ambition takes the long road up rather than any shortcut.
sun-in-aquarius: Opposite its home and so in its detriment, the Sun lends its light to the group rather than the individual. Science, new methods of healing and strange or advanced beliefs draw the month's curiosity, and friends in useful positions open doors. Popularity is easy. Personal warmth is harder to locate in the cool intelligence.
sun-in-pisces: Life withdraws from the public gaze. Hospitals, prisons, institutions and quiet charitable work hold the month's attention, and what happens behind the scenes matters more than what is announced. Psychic sensitivity and a pull toward the occult run high. Reputations that are attacked tend, in the end, to be vindicated.
moon-in-aries: A couple of days of quick, independent feeling. Moods flare at interference, plans get started before they are thought through, and setbacks are met with a fresh attempt rather than a pause. Courage is cheap and plentiful. The weakness is restlessness that abandons one venture for the next before either has a chance.
moon-in-taurus: Settled and exalted, the Moon rests here. The Taurean steadiness tones down her changeability and for two days the mood is gentle, determined and fond of pleasure. Meals, music, hospitality and the comfort of things that stay put all come easily. Not much shifts, and that is the point, since stubbornness is the only shadow.
moon-in-gemini: Feeling turns quick and curious for a couple of days. Conversations multiply, news is read and passed on, and restlessness looks for somewhere to go and someone to meet. Emergencies are handled with resourcefulness. The mood flits between subjects and does not settle, so nothing is felt deeply until the Moon moves on.
moon-in-cancer: Cancer is where the Moon is at home, and for a couple of days the mood is kind, sympathetic and domestic, drawn to the kitchen, the family and the comforts of staying in. Effort is not favoured and most people drift with the tide. Sensitivity to atmosphere runs high. Digestion follows feeling.
moon-in-leo: The mood brightens and organises itself for a couple of days. Feeling turns warm, self-reliant and a little theatrical, with a taste for leadership in whatever circle is to hand. Generosity and fair dealing come easily, and so does popularity. The shadow is pride that needs an audience to be sure of itself.
moon-in-virgo: Feeling goes quiet and exacting for two days. Memory sharpens, study comes easily, and attention turns to diet, health and small corrections of method. The mood is reserved and dislikes flattery or display, happier serving than commanding. The shadow is fussiness, a readiness to find the flaw in every pleasant thing.
moon-in-libra: Company is the mood for a couple of days. Feeling turns kind, agreeable and optimistic, fond of social pleasures and quick to make friends. Judgement is balanced and art and music draw the ear. The drawback is a reluctance to decide anything alone, and a politeness that smooths over what ought to be said.
moon-in-scorpio: The Moon is in her fall here and turns intense for a couple of days. Feeling is courageous, stubborn and unwilling to be pushed, blunt in speech and quick to resent imposition, yet softened at once by kindness. Secrets and the occult draw attention. The shadow is excess, appetite chasing sensation rather than meaning.
moon-in-sagittarius: Restlessness takes the body outdoors for two days. The mood is active, jovial and good-humoured, fond of walking, riding, animals and anywhere far from here. Religion, law and philosophy are discussed with more cheer than rigour. Companionship is easy, but left unchecked the good humour slides into indolence and self-indulgence.
moon-in-capricorn: In her detriment, the sign opposite her home, the Moon goes cold and careful for a couple of days. Feeling is held back, slights are felt keenly, and help comes from those higher up rather than from pushing forward. Thrift is the mood. The shadow is a fear of want that denies every present comfort.
moon-in-aquarius: Imagination runs vivid for a couple of days and intuition does the work reason usually does. The mood is sociable, courteous and kindly, and friends gather without effort. Images rise before the mind's eye almost tangible. The other face is erratic feeling, moods that change direction without warning and for no reason anyone can name.
moon-in-pisces: Receptiveness is the mood for two days. Imagination runs fertile, feeling is easily stirred and music is played and heard with unusual inspiration. Dreaming is preferred to acting, and sympathy comes before judgement. The shadow is self-pity and faint-heartedness, a willingness to be flattered by anything that moves the emotions.
mercury-in-aries: Arguments are quick and plentiful for the month. Repartee sharpens, disputes are enjoyed for their own sake and claims run a little larger than the facts, without anyone quite intending it. Ideas are grasped fast. The shadow is leaping before looking, with decisions made at speed and unmade just as fast.
mercury-in-taurus: Minds are slow to make up and nearly impossible to change once made. Judgement is reliable for being built on thought, and silence is treated as golden, so the month favours counsel kept and secrets held. Taste in music, art and literature is sound. The shadow is obstinacy and a dour refusal to hear anything new.
mercury-in-gemini: Gemini is Mercury's own sign, and the planet is at home and moves freely here. Novelty appeals and the month favours travel, investigation and a quick change of scene, with judgement shrewd enough to know good value on sight and unburdened by settled opinions. Trade and argument both go well. Depth suffers, since nothing holds attention long enough.
mercury-in-cancer: Memory is clear and adaptable for the month. Thinking fits itself to the room it is in, taking on the opinions around it and finding a place in any company. Praise is wanted and criticism is avoided, which keeps conversation pleasant. The shadow is a mind so accommodating that it never quite says what it thinks.
mercury-in-leo: Speech turns blunt, warm and confident. Ideals are high, equivocation is despised and the month favours organising, leading and saying plainly what is meant, with a quick temper and a kind heart underneath. Children and pleasure get attention. The shadow is inconstancy and a gambler's faith in schemes that flatter.
mercury-in-virgo: Both at home and exalted here, Mercury is at the height of its powers. Thought is clear, logical and scientific, expression fluent, and conclusions practical because they are looked at before anyone leaps. Diet, chemistry and fine handwork prosper. The shadow is irritability, a petulant eye that finds the flaw in everything it meets.
mercury-in-libra: Broad, well-balanced minds and an uncommon ease of expression mark the month. Public speaking goes well, so does singing, and art and music are discussed with taste. Agreements are weighed carefully. The shadow is trouble through partnerships, disputes that end up in law and promises made by two parties who meant different things.
mercury-in-scorpio: Wit turns sharp and the tongue stings. Thinking is shrewd, resourceful and dauntless, able to work through difficulties that would crush a gentler month, and drawn to secrets and the occult as a needle to a magnet. Sarcasm comes easily. The shadow is cynicism, contrariness and a quarrel with every view but its own.
mercury-in-sagittarius: In its detriment, the sign opposite its home, Mercury still speaks well here. Thought turns philosophical and religious, impatient of convention where it cramps free speech but kept within law and order. Travel for its own sake appeals, and so do animals and strange customs. The shadow is sophistry, argument twisted to serve a conclusion already reached.
mercury-in-capricorn: Thinking goes critical, penetrating and a little suspicious for the month. Secrets are ferreted out, persistence is inexhaustible, and the mind is practical, thrifty and drawn to science. Diplomacy comes with the suspicion, and something is always put by for a rainy day. The shadow is hardness, a spitefulness that keeps score.
mercury-in-aquarius: Originality and a love of liberty mark the month's thinking. Conventions are repudiated, fashion ignored, and ideas on social questions run a long way ahead of what the world is ready for. Science, mathematics and astrology draw interest, and intellectual company gathers easily. The shadow is disloyalty, criticism of friends behind their backs.
mercury-in-pisces: Mercury is in its detriment and its fall here, and thinks by imagination rather than logic. Hunches arrive without reasons and are startlingly often right. The month is kindly and benevolent, good for health foods, chemistry and quiet work. The shadow is worry and gloom, a mind that cannot stop turning over what it cannot prove.
venus-in-aries: Venus burns hot here, in her detriment, the sign opposite her home. Affection is ardent and declared at once, popularity comes easily and attachments are made in haste. Sympathy is impulsive and sometimes spent on an unworthy cause, and money goes freely. The fire does not last, and what it leaves behind is often disagreement.
venus-in-taurus: Venus is at home in Taurus, strong and comfortable. Money comes through effort and the month favours earning, sociability and the pleasure of being liked back. Opinions on correct form and good manners are firmly held and defended. Generosity is real but never extravagant, and the shadow is a tenacity that will not change its mind.
venus-in-gemini: Words are chosen with ease and carry a rhythm that pleases the ear. The month favours poetry, letters, short journeys and goodwill among neighbours and siblings, and affection is expressed more than it is felt. Taste refines the mind. The shadow is plurality, the heart divided between two places or two people.
venus-in-cancer: Affection turns toward home, memory and devotion, and imagination runs fruitful. The month favours tenderness, hospitality and a religious or psychic feeling that is receptive rather than discriminating. Attraction draws without selecting. The shadow is being taken in, whether by a mood, a medium or anyone who knows how to be comforting.
venus-in-leo: Love compounds itself for the month. Tenderness runs deep, loyalty once given does not waver, and the affections assert themselves without embarrassment. Entertainment, theatre, children and education all prosper, and favour comes from those above in the social scale. The shadow is pride in love, a loyalty that demands the same back.
venus-in-virgo: Practical and quiet, Venus is in her fall here. Sympathy goes to the sick, and the month favours nursing, dietetics, chemistry and every form of care that shows itself in service rather than words. Relations with employees and subordinates are pleasant. Affection is given in deeds, and the shadow is a love that cannot stop correcting.
venus-in-libra: Her own sign, Libra puts Venus at home and in her element. Partnership and marriage prosper, music and art come easily, and public life finds an appreciative audience. Harmony is wanted more than anything and usually found. The shadow is a wish to please that avoids conflict until the conflict is the only thing left.
venus-in-scorpio: Venus runs to extremes here, in her detriment, the sign opposite her home. Desire is intense, luxury and anything that stirs the senses are craved, and jealousy arrives with attachment. Deep devotion can serve as an outlet, and legacies and shared money move. The shadow is appetite that undermines what it loves and reputations smirched in the process.
venus-in-sagittarius: Goodwill is the mood of the month. Affection blends with generosity, and the season favours philanthropy, religious devotion, drama, art and music, all with a genial optimism. Imagination and intuition run warm. The shadow is a love that wanders, plural and restless, and a kindness too easily persuaded.
venus-in-capricorn: Social success comes with a chill. The month favours advancement in business and society, but Venus and Saturn do not blend well, and popularity is never quite secure. Unions are made for convenience, across disparities of age or station, and honour is jealously guarded. The shadow is melancholy and a fall from the pinnacle just reached.
venus-in-aquarius: Affection follows the heart's inclination and ignores the rules. Independence, sincerity and a disregard of convention mark the month's attachments, and friends prove the surest route to any success. Sudden declarations arrive without warning. The shadow is unpredictability, with no one, not even the speaker, able to say what is coming next.
venus-in-pisces: Exalted in Pisces, Venus is at her most tender. Feeling runs deep and is toned down by a sorrow that wants to help anyone sick or heavy-laden. Music is the month's outlet and is heard with unusual depth, and compassion is boundless. The shadow is imposition, money and trust taken by those who know how to ask.
mars-in-aries: Mars is at home here, and the weeks run hot and fast. Energy is abundant, patience is scarce, and the impossible gets attempted on sheer audacity, often successfully. Sport, machinery and new ventures all draw the surplus. The shadow is temper, haste and the accidents that come of both: burns, collisions, and arguments that flare before anyone has thought.
mars-in-taurus: In its detriment, the sign opposite its home, Mars loses speed and gains weight. Effort goes into earning and holding, and the mood is a quiet persistence that does not recognise defeat. Money moves generously and sometimes foolishly. The shadow is stubbornness hardening into vindictiveness, with grudges kept long after the quarrel is over.
mars-in-gemini: Argument is the sport of these weeks. Wits are sharp, speech is blunt, and nobody beats about the bush, which is refreshing until it turns caustic. Debate, law, writing and engineering all profit from a mind that grasps a problem quickly. The weak point is follow-through: decisions wobble, promises slip, and short journeys turn fractious.
mars-in-cancer: Mars is in its fall here, and the energy turns inward on the household. Effort goes into providing, protecting and gathering whatever makes for comfort, and nobody tolerates a rival authority under the roof. Temper is uncertain, and occupations get taken up and dropped. The shadow is domestic quarrelling, restless moves, and carelessness with fire at home.
mars-in-leo: Courtship, play and risk all get pursued with the same intensity. The weeks are fearless, honest and embarrassingly direct, and whatever is wanted is wooed until it gives way. Positions of trust suit the mood, since the sense of honour runs high. Arguments are forceful enough to raise opposition, and pride in daring tips easily into recklessness.
mars-in-virgo: Energy goes into work, and the work is done shrewdly. Ideas get grasped and elaborated, research and industry move quickly, and anything touching health, hygiene, medicine or food is especially busy. Recovery from setbacks is fast. The shadow is worry over mostly imaginary troubles, irritability at colleagues, and a critical dissatisfaction with everything about the job.
mars-in-libra: Fighting is done through partnership, since Mars is in its detriment here, the sign opposite its home. Attraction runs ardent and demonstrative, art and beauty are pursued with unusual appetite, and social and public life are lively. Lawyers are busy. The shadow is fickleness: affections played with, scandal following, and the community quick to voice its opposition.
mars-in-scorpio: Energy is inexhaustible and not always polite, with Mars at home here. Manner is blunt, mentality sharp, and whatever goal is set gets reached regardless of what stands in the way. Surgery, policing, soldiering and anything needing sharp tools go well. The shadow is a biting tongue, quarrels, and excess in the passions that saps the vitality.
mars-in-sagittarius: Debate turns to the serious subjects: law, philosophy, religion, and who is right about them. Candour and enthusiasm run high, travel and outdoor sport are favoured, and the period produces vivid stories told by keen observers. Oratory sharpens. The shadow is a quarrelsome superciliousness toward anyone who disagrees, and accidents on the road.
mars-in-capricorn: Mars is exalted here, and ambition gets the patience it needs. Courage and persistence are both plentiful, so great enterprises are taken on and carried through, and the community rewards competence with responsibility. The wider the scope the better. The shadow is overreach: taking on more than can be finished, rashness dressed up as ambition, and a vindictive temper.
mars-in-aquarius: Ingenuity is the keynote, and electrical, mechanical and technical work moves fastest. Friends help ambitions along, and causes, utilities and public enterprises draw the energy. Speech is quick and original. The shadow is resentment of authority and a bombastic insistence on being treated with proper respect, which makes everyone hard to get along with and tempts losses through speculation.
mars-in-pisces: Authority is exercised out of sight, in hospitals, prisons, investigations and back rooms, and love affairs are kept from public view. Secret enemies are active, and drink is a temptation. The weeks are good for quiet, hidden effort and poor for honesty, since the shadow is untruthfulness and the entanglements with the law that follow it.
jupiter-in-aries: Optimism takes the lead. The year favours pioneers, new methods and progressive ventures, and the appetite for advancement is high-spirited without quite being rash. Law, writing and outdoor games prosper, and popularity comes easily in business and society. The shadow is impatience: impulsive acts and a show of temper under pressure, with esteem lost in the process.
jupiter-in-taurus: Wealth is the subject, and it accumulates. Generosity runs warm but not lavish, since every proposition is examined on its merits before a hand is extended, and the open-handedness is reserved for those nearest. Home and family come first. The shadow is extravagance for show, rich food, and the trouble with creditors that follows a year of indulgence.
jupiter-in-gemini: In its detriment, the sign opposite its home, Jupiter spreads itself across many subjects at once. Writing, mathematics, invention and the occult all draw interest, and travel brings pleasure and profit. The manner is courteous and friendly. The shadow is dispersal: losses while travelling, narrow escapes, legal and religious disputes, and difficulty with siblings and near relatives.
jupiter-in-cancer: Jupiter is exalted here, and the year is kind and well fed. Imagination is vivid and dreams run utopian, yet a practical streak keeps property, land and investment growing, and inheritance and parental help flow. Courtesy is general and the world feels at peace. Pleasures of the table are the shadow, and gluttony eventually costs more than it gives.
jupiter-in-leo: Nobility is in fashion. Kindness and courage, loyalty and self-restraint are prized together, and leadership is craved and generally deserved. Vitality is strong, culture and refinement are valued, speculation turns out well, and the year favours positions of trust. The shadow is a cruel sensuality and a fondness for pleasure that loses money by investment and gambling.
jupiter-in-virgo: Caution and analysis take over, with Jupiter in its detriment, the sign opposite its home. The year is good at sifting truth from error, and no secret survives a patient examination. Business and the professions prosper, and those who serve prove loyal. The shadow is a carping cynicism, mistrust of everyone, and losses through employees who have been treated badly.
jupiter-in-libra: Benevolence turns social. Music, art, literature and company are all pursued as things that lift humanity, and the year is sociable, conscientious and popular, with gain arriving through partners and public life. Kindness is generally returned. The shadow is indulgence that becomes public scandal, and prestige lost just when it seemed most secure.
jupiter-in-scorpio: Ardent and self-reliant, the year meets every exigency with resourcefulness. Practical everyday occupations succeed, families grow and are provided for, and the occult draws serious investigation. Aggression here is constructive rather than quarrelsome. The shadow is the lower nature indulged beyond measure, a taste for rich and expensive things, and the sickness that follows.
jupiter-in-sagittarius: Jupiter is at home here, and good fortune is general. The mind is broad, humane and philosophical, reverence comes naturally, and leaders rise to prominence in church, state, science and philosophy. The year is confident. The shadow is cheap display, gambling, extravagance and narrow sectarian views, with legal and financial trouble following close behind.
jupiter-in-capricorn: Jupiter is in its fall here, and expansion proceeds by economy. Ambition is self-controlled, waste is abhorred, and authority is earned through honesty and promises kept, so esteem comes slowly and lasts. Government service suits the year, and confidences are entrusted to those who keep them. The shadow is miserliness: hoarding everything and denying all but necessities.
jupiter-in-aquarius: Friendship is the fortune of the year. Optimism is humane and original, and the company of scientists, mystics, writers and musicians helps hopes and ambitions along. Societies, associations and official positions within them prosper, and the mood is philosophic. The shadow is restlessness, an erratic enthusiasm for revolutionary ideas, and a disinclination for serious work that earns distrust.
jupiter-in-pisces: Mercy is the keynote, and Jupiter is at home here. Charity, hospitality and ministry to the sick, the imprisoned and the outcast draw the year's energy, and sensitivity to the invisible world brings psychic experience and occult study. Music and art flourish. The shadow is a nerveless vacillation that indulges every vice and lives off others.
saturn-in-aries: Saturn is in its fall here, and discipline is hard to sustain. Poise, tact, patience and perseverance are all available in minor measure, and industry is rewarded wherever it is kept up. Self-reliance has to be learnt. The shadow is quick anger that turns to spite, with jealousy and malice settling in where restraint has given way.
saturn-in-taurus: Speech slows and gains weight. Decisions take time, positions once taken are held stubbornly, and secrets are well kept. The years favour quiet, solid work and the patient building of what will last. Financial difficulty is the plain shadow, along with a temper quicker than the manner suggests and trouble in saying what is meant.
saturn-in-gemini: Thought becomes deep, orderly and one-pointed. Mathematics and the serious branches of literature are favoured, especially industrial and mechanical subjects, and the mind adapts to circumstances and copes with what arises. Communication is sober. The shadow is trouble with siblings, with law and writing, and danger on short journeys.
saturn-in-cancer: In its detriment, the sign opposite its home, Saturn finds it hard to express its virtues. Judgment about houses, land and property is reliable, and thrift, economy and solid home comfort are favoured. Appetite is kept under control. The shadow is domestic gloom: a kill-joy restraint on every ambition, and sorrow and disappointment accumulating as the years go on.
saturn-in-leo: Authority works for its position. Saturn is in its detriment here, the sign opposite its home, so favour has to come from those higher up, and public appointments go to tact, diplomacy, system and executive ability. Energy is conserved rather than spent. The shadow is cruelty and jealousy, with ambition stooping to underhanded methods.
saturn-in-virgo: Study deepens. The years favour a scientific mind turned on the deeper problems of life, a thrifty and frugal economy, and an innate ability to manage others. Work is methodical and the detail is attended to. The shadow is hypochondria, with attention fixed on illness that is mostly imaginary and money spent on every remedy for it.
saturn-in-libra: Saturn is exalted here, and its finest qualities come out. Public esteem and recognition follow from justice done patiently, partnerships are chaste and reliable, and health and longevity are favoured. The years reward fairness. The shadow is treachery in partnership, lawsuits lost, and public disfavour where balance has not been kept.
saturn-in-scorpio: The fire of Mars meets the forethought of Saturn, and the combination is close to invincible. Resourcefulness under the most difficult conditions, indomitable courage and patient persistence make the years good for engineering, construction and pioneer undertakings. Legacy, thrift and marriage improve fortunes. The shadow is worry, ill health, and partners who are dull and exacting.
saturn-in-sagittarius: Aspiration gets discipline. The years favour charitable and philanthropic work, self-help under just laws, and a true religious impulse, and those who serve the public good are trusted, honoured and in demand. Philosophy is taken seriously. The shadow is insincerity: cynicism, sarcasm, and ambition for positions of trust held for selfish purposes.
saturn-in-capricorn: Saturn is at home here, and its virtues are pronounced. Honesty and integrity stand like rock, and determination works toward the goal no matter how long it takes, so handicaps and obstacles are ultimately overcome. The years reward patience with esteem. The shadow is gloom: a biased view of life, general dissatisfaction, and cunning that cannot be trusted.
saturn-in-aquarius: The outlook is humane, and Saturn, at home here, keeps it sober. Speech is distinct and deliberate, seriousness governs every affair, and friendships among the aged, the wealthy and the intellectual help the years along. Sympathy is lasting. The shadow is shrewdness turned predatory, with confidence and friendship gained only to be preyed upon.
saturn-in-pisces: Quiet lines of work prosper. Laboratories, research, institutions for those in the community's care, and anything that keeps away from the public suit the years best. Home-bodies are content and seclusion is productive. The shadow is confinement, by chronic illness or by imprisonment, and persistent enemies who do not let a persecution drop.
uranus-in-aries: Originality turns impulsive. The years are full of energy and ambition, ingenious and resourceful with mechanical and electrical difficulty, and nobody stays long in one place. Manner is abrupt and brusque, and offence is given where none is intended. Changes of place and position are often forced by the blunt way of speaking.
uranus-in-taurus: Intuition meets stubbornness. Once minds are made up, neither persuasion nor threat will turn them, and purposes are held with quiet determination for years. Finance is where the surprises land: sudden unexpected reverses on the one hand, comfortable circumstances on the other. The shadow is suspicion and jealousy where the will has hardened.
uranus-in-gemini: Science, electricity, aviation and every out-of-the-way subject attract the original mind. The years are broad-minded and thoroughly progressive, pioneering whatever is new and modern, and astrology and occultism are taken up. Neighbours and siblings are on good terms. The shadow is eccentricity full of vagaries, cranks disliked by everyone, and accidents on short journeys.
uranus-in-cancer: Sensitivity sharpens. The years attune the collective to psychic currents, and the home becomes the place where they are felt, for good or ill depending on what is done with them. Families separate, usually against their will. The shadow is an uncertain temper, irritable and impatient, that brings the separation on and then calls it unjust.
uranus-in-leo: Rebellion is the mood, and restraint or contradiction is not tolerated. Likes and dislikes are strong, conventions around love are disregarded, and affairs of the heart are inconstant, on with the new before off with the old. Inventive genius shows in education, journalism and entertainment. The shadow is a self-assertion that creates opposition wherever it goes.
uranus-in-virgo: Work gets reinvented. The years favour a keen, original, scientific and mechanical mind, strong intuition and a business bent that gains through employing others. Method and invention combine. The shadow is strange ailments and hypochondria, a fractious irritability, and disappointment through limitations in employment that nobody seems able to overcome.
uranus-in-libra: Partnership is where the changes land. Literary and artistic ability take unusual and original lines, often touching the occult, and unions form with people of strikingly independent character. Intuition and imagination are vivid. The shadow is sudden loss of partners, divorce where fidelity cannot be kept, and trouble with the authorities over eccentric or anarchistic activity.
uranus-in-scorpio: Will hardens into something forceful. Obstacles are overcome by dogged persistence, the mind is sharp, shrewd and secretive, and originality in mechanics and science amounts to genius. Both the occult and the physical draw deep concentration. The shadow is accident and sudden death by explosion, electricity and unusual agencies, and the creative force abused.
uranus-in-sagittarius: Belief goes out of the ordinary. Intuition runs strong, dreams and visions are vivid, and the occult arts are practised as well as theorised. The years grasp the religious and educational problems of the day and travel for the education of it. The shadow is an erratic mentality about law and religion, forcing one-sided views on everyone.
uranus-in-capricorn: Enterprise turns original. Ambition is serious and persevering, responsibility is acutely felt, and new ideas of business succeed, especially in electrical and aerial lines. Structures get rebuilt from unexpected angles. The shadow is a stubborn, self-willed mind bound to rule or ruin, at odds with society and relatives, with sudden changes of employment and environment.
uranus-in-aquarius: Humanity at large is what the years want. Intuition and originality strengthen, and the energies run into humanitarian lines, devotion to friendship, and a sincere wish to help whoever is in trouble. Inventive genius flourishes and hopes are generally realised. The shadow is ambitions too erratic to carry out, and pretended friends who use the trust for their own ends.
uranus-in-pisces: The occult arts attract study and ability, and friends and associations favour them. Sensitivity to the invisible runs high, and what is hidden surfaces unexpectedly. The shadow is mediumship followed to obsession, a flighty and erratic mind, unexpected misfortune and scandal, and a vague fear of impending disaster that haunts even the years when fortune smiles.
neptune-in-aries: Idealism takes on a crusading edge for a long stretch of years. Causes are embraced with the zeal of a new faith, and movements to lift humanity onto a nobler footing gather people willing to lead from the front. The shadow is the same fervour turned destructive, a conviction that a better world justifies tearing down whoever stands in its way.
neptune-in-taurus: Beauty and comfort become something close to a creed over these years. Music, fine things and the pleasures of the senses are valued for the way they soften life, and land and property carry a dreamlike promise of security. The shadow is appetite without a floor, a generation that confuses indulgence with wellbeing and pays for it slowly.
neptune-in-gemini: Ideas carry an unusual charge of inspiration. Writing, speech, invention and the mathematical arts all draw on something beyond plain reasoning, and the gifted find words for what was previously only sensed. The shadow is a restless, scattered mind that cannot settle on anything, and a climate of rumour and clever deception in which the credulous are easily taken in.
neptune-in-cancer: Feeling runs close to the surface and sympathy comes easily. Home, family and belonging are idealised, and the sorrows and joys of others are understood almost before they are spoken. Devotion of every kind flourishes. The shadow is a self-indulgence that undermines the household by hint and mood rather than open quarrel, and a hunger for comfort that reaches for drink or drugs.
neptune-in-leo: Glamour, romance and the arts of performance set the tone for a generation. Warmth and generosity are admired, teaching flourishes through a real feel for how others learn, and love is pursued as something transcendent. The shadow is impulse over judgment, a taste for spectacle that cannot hold an issue to its end, and the disappointment that follows idealised romance.
neptune-in-virgo: Inspiration and analysis are asked to work together. Service, craft and the care of the body take on a devotional quality, gentleness softens the cool habits of criticism, and ideals of purity shape how people eat, work and love, sometimes to the point of oddness. The shadow is an imagination that invents every illness it has read about and a surrender of judgment to whatever influence is speaking.
neptune-in-libra: Partnership is idealised. Music, poetry and the arts of harmony flourish, and the hope of a union that is spiritual as well as practical runs through the collective imagination of the period. Marriage is reimagined around it. The shadow is the same longing pursued in secret, through clandestine and unconventional attachments, and a sentimentality too soft to hold a relationship to its promises.
neptune-in-scorpio: Hidden things exert a pull. Research into the secrets of nature, whether in laboratories or in the occult, is driven by an inspired perception that reaches past reason, and what is undertaken with that energy tends to get done. Sexuality and death lose their taboos. The shadow is passion without restraint, a thirst for drink and drugs, and a fascination with dissolution that pulls people under.
neptune-in-sagittarius: Faith, philosophy and the far horizon are suffused with longing. Dreams and visions are taken seriously, devotion deepens, religion loosens from its institutions, and travel is pursued as much for its promise of transcendence as for the places themselves. The shadow is foreboding, a mind preyed on by imagined dangers and distant threats, and journeys that disappoint or turn to trouble.
neptune-in-capricorn: Imagination is put to work on large structures. Business, government and the long game of institutions attract a contemplative, far-sighted intelligence that concentrates on intricate problems and solves them, and the serious arts of investigation thrive. The shadow is melancholy, a secretiveness that shades into deceit at the top of organisations, and a withdrawal from society into private fortresses.
neptune-in-aquarius: Utopia is in the air. The wish to free the whole world from its social, mental and physical ills gives the period its visionaries, who are ahead of their time and look like dreamers or dangers to the conventional while the progressive adore them. New fields of knowledge are opened by people who sense the finer forces first. The shadow is ideals that collapse into discredit and disgrace.
neptune-in-pisces: Mysticism comes into its own, and compassion with it. The period favours quiet, unobtrusive devotion, the pursuit of spiritual knowledge at first hand rather than on authority, and a tenderness towards suffering that draws help from unexpected quarters. The shadow is dissolution, deception by hidden enemies, escape into drink and drugs, and a surrender of boundaries that ends in confinement or self-undoing.
pluto-in-aries: A generation is born to force beginnings. Power is seized by the bold, war and the technology of force are transformed, and the individual's right to act is dug up from under old restraints and remade. Identity itself becomes a battleground. The shadow is a violence that finds no cause too small and burns through everything in its hurry to start again.
pluto-in-taurus: Wealth, land and the material basis of life are dug up and transformed over a long span. Who owns what, how money holds its value and what the earth is allowed to give are questions forced open and answered by whoever holds the deeper power. Stubborn systems of possession are eliminated or rebuilt from the ground. The shadow is greed with the patience to outlast all resistance.
pluto-in-gemini: Language, information and the means of communication are overturned at the root. A generation grows up inside a transformation of how ideas travel, and the power that comes with controlling the channel is fought over and reorganised. Old vocabularies die and new ones carry an obsessive intensity. The shadow is propaganda, a saturation of words that leaves nothing unmanipulated and no one sure what is true.
pluto-in-cancer: Home, family and the idea of a homeland are torn down and rebuilt. A generation is shaped by the collapse of domestic security, by migration and by the state taking on the parent's role, and it holds on to what remains with a fierce protective intensity. Belonging is remade at the root. The shadow is a fear for survival that hardens into tribalism.
pluto-in-leo: Self-expression, creativity and the appetite for recognition are charged with enormous power. A generation born under it believes in its own significance, transforms entertainment, youth and romance into forces that shape societies, and expects to be heard. Leadership becomes a stage. The shadow is a hunger for attention that eliminates whatever will not applaud, and rulers who confuse themselves with the sun.
pluto-in-virgo: Work, health and the arrangements of daily service are dug up and remade. A generation is shaped by the industrialisation of medicine, labour and food, by an obsession with efficiency and purity, and by the discovery of how much harm hides in ordinary routines. Craft becomes a form of power. The shadow is a perfectionism that eliminates the imperfect, including the human.
pluto-in-libra: Partnership and the balance of power between people are transformed at the root. Marriage, law and the terms of fairness are taken apart by a generation that refuses the old contracts and negotiates new ones with rare intensity. Diplomacy becomes a theatre of hidden force. The shadow is harmony used as a weapon, and relationships dominated by the question of who holds control.
pluto-in-scorpio: Everything hidden is forced to the surface. Sex, death, debt and the secret workings of power are investigated with an obsessive thoroughness, and a generation is shaped by crises that reveal what institutions and bodies had kept concealed. Taboos break and the broken ones never fully return. The shadow is paranoia, cruelty and a fascination with destruction for its own sake.
pluto-in-sagittarius: Belief itself is the territory of transformation. Religion, education, law and the shared story of what the world is for are dug up at the root, and a generation is shaped by the global reach of ideas and the violent collision of convictions. Travel and trade alter the scale of everything. The shadow is fanaticism, the certainty that one truth justifies eliminating all others.
pluto-in-capricorn: Institutions are taken down to their foundations. Government, banking, corporations and the structures of authority are exposed, hollowed and rebuilt over a long span, and a generation grows up watching what it was told was permanent prove otherwise. Real power is revealed behind the official kind. The shadow is a ruthless concentration of control and the corruption of those left holding it.
pluto-in-aquarius: Collective power moves into networks, technology and the crowd. The relationship between the individual and the group is transformed at the root, old hierarchies are flattened or replaced by newer and less visible ones, and a generation is shaped by machines that think and movements that organise themselves. The shadow is surveillance, a system that leaves no one unobserved, and revolutions that devour their own.
pluto-in-pisces: Faith, compassion and the boundaries of the self are dissolved and remade at the root. Religion is transformed from below, the collective imagination becomes a site of real power, and a generation learns what suffering and sacrifice ask of it. Hidden things return as a flood. The shadow is mass delusion, the loss of the individual in the tide, and the exploitation of the helpless by those who claim to save them.
node-in-aries: The pull is towards courage and the willingness to act alone. The collective is asked to stop deferring, to stop waiting for consensus and to find out what it wants, with the habit of over-accommodation in partnership left behind as the path of least resistance. Growth comes through initiative. The shadow is a self-assertion that mistakes the fight itself for the point.
node-in-taurus: Growth lies in the direction of simplicity, patience and what can be held in the hand. The collective is pulled away from crisis, debt and the dramas of entanglement and towards stable value, the body, the land and the slow building of what lasts. Security is to be earned rather than seized. The shadow is a comfort that refuses to let anything change at all.
node-in-gemini: Curiosity, conversation and the willingness to hold more than one view are the direction of growth. Grand certainties and the preacher's voice are the habit to be left behind, and the collective is drawn towards neighbours, facts, questions and the local exchange of ideas. Listening becomes the lesson. The shadow is a scattering of attention that never settles on a truth.
node-in-cancer: Home, care and the feeling life are where the collective is being pulled. Ambition, status and the compulsion to manage everything from above are the familiar ground to be left, and attention is drawn towards families, roots, nourishment and the acknowledgement of what people actually feel. Tenderness becomes a public value. The shadow is a retreat into the clan that admits no stranger.
node-in-leo: Growth lies in the direction of the heart, of creativity, play and the courage to be seen. The collective is asked to leave the safe distance of the group and the cool detachment of the observer and to risk individual warmth, performance and pleasure in being alive. Children and the arts come forward. The shadow is a vanity that confuses attention with love.
node-in-virgo: Precision, service, health and the honest work of improving things are the direction of travel. The collective is pulled out of the fog of escapism and vague idealism and towards practical remedies, discernment and the ordinary discipline of daily routines. Competence becomes a form of care. The shadow is a critical fussiness that loses the whole for the parts.
node-in-libra: The pull is towards cooperation, fairness and the other person's point of view. Independence pursued for its own sake and the reflex of going it alone are the habits to be outgrown, and the collective is drawn towards diplomacy, partnership, balance and the arts of peace. Relationship becomes the teacher. The shadow is a compliance that forgets what it wanted.
node-in-scorpio: Depth, intimacy and the willingness to let something end are the direction of growth. Material security and the comforts of accumulation are the ground being left behind, and the collective is drawn towards shared resources, psychological honesty and the transformation that only crisis brings. What is dead is to be released. The shadow is a fascination with control and destruction.
node-in-sagittarius: Meaning, faith and the long view are where the collective is being pulled. Attention is drawn away from gossip, endless information and the clever argument that settles nothing, and towards philosophy, foreign perspectives, higher learning and a conviction worth living by. Truth is the destination. The shadow is a self-righteousness that preaches rather than learns.
node-in-capricorn: The pull is towards responsibility, structure and the slow achievement of something durable. Dependence, nostalgia and the emotional comfort of staying small are the familiar ground to be left, and the collective is drawn towards maturity, institutions worth building and the authority that comes from doing the work. Discipline becomes the lesson. The shadow is an ambition that forgets why it climbed.
node-in-aquarius: Growth lies in the direction of the group, of friendship, ideals and the future held in common. The collective is asked to leave behind the need for individual applause and to find a place in something larger, in movements, networks and the science of what benefits everyone. Detachment is the medicine. The shadow is a coldness that cannot love anyone in particular.
node-in-pisces: Compassion, surrender and faith in what cannot be measured are the direction of travel. The collective is pulled out of over-analysis, criticism and the anxious management of detail and towards imagination, forgiveness, art, spirituality and the acceptance that not everything can be fixed. Mercy becomes the lesson. The shadow is an escapism that will not face anything at all.
chiron-in-aries: The wound is in the right to exist on one's own terms. Over these years the collective confronts a damaged sense of self, of being unwelcome or unentitled to want anything, and the remedy is found by acting anyway. Anger and assertion are learned as healing arts. The shadow is a rage that keeps the hurt open and a conviction that the fight is all there is.
chiron-in-taurus: Security, the body and the sense of being worth anything are where the wound lies. Scarcity, the loss of what was held and estrangement from the physical world are exposed, and the remedy comes through learning what truly has value and caring for the earth and the senses with patience. Slowness heals. The shadow is a hoarding that can never feel safe.
chiron-in-gemini: Speech and the hope of being understood carry the wound. Years under it bring to the surface the hurt of not being heard, of words that fail or deceive, and of learning that was mocked or withheld, and the remedy is found in honest conversation and the courage to ask questions. Teaching becomes a medicine. The shadow is a cleverness used to keep the wound from being seen.
chiron-in-cancer: The wound is in home, mothering and the sense of belonging anywhere. The collective faces what was unnourished in its families and nations, the exile and the hunger for care, and the remedy is found in learning to provide what was missing, to others first and so to itself. Shelter heals. The shadow is a neediness that drives away the care it wants.
chiron-in-leo: Creativity, the heart and the shame of being seen hold the wound. Years under it bring forward the hurt of talents dismissed, of children not celebrated and of a joy that learned to hide, and the remedy is found in making things and performing them regardless. Play becomes a cure. The shadow is a demand for applause that no audience can satisfy.
chiron-in-virgo: The wound is in the body, in work and in the belief that nothing is ever good enough. Illness, overwork and a punishing perfectionism are exposed at collective scale, and the remedy is found in the humble arts of healing, in service that does not sacrifice the server and in accepting imperfection. Craft mends. The shadow is a worry about health that becomes its own disease.
chiron-in-libra: Partnership and the fear of never being chosen are where the wound lies. Years under it surface the hurt of unfair bargains, of marriages that cost one party the self and of a peace kept at any price, and the remedy is found in relationships that stay honest about their imbalances. Fairness heals. The shadow is a dependence that mistakes being needed for being loved.
chiron-in-scorpio: The wound is in trust, in intimacy and in the fear of loss. Betrayal, abuse, debt and the long shadow of death are brought into the open at collective scale, and the remedy is found in going through rather than around them, in grief fully felt and in power shared. Honesty about the dark heals. The shadow is a cruelty that passes the wound to the next person.
chiron-in-sagittarius: Faith and the meaning of it all carry the wound. Years under it expose the hurt of beliefs that failed, of teachers who betrayed and of a truth that turned out to be someone else's, and the remedy is found in a philosophy built from lived experience rather than inherited. Journeys mend. The shadow is a cynicism that will believe in nothing again.
chiron-in-capricorn: The wound is in authority, achievement and the father's place. The collective confronts what was withheld by institutions and elders, the shame of failure and the loneliness of responsibility carried too young, and the remedy is found in building structures that hold people rather than break them. Mature care heals. The shadow is an ambition that tries to earn what was never conditional.
chiron-in-aquarius: Belonging to the group is where the wound lies. Years under it surface the hurt of the outsider, of being too strange or too early for the time, and of ideals that cost friendships, and the remedy is found in communities that make a place for the odd one and in difference used as a gift. Fellowship heals. The shadow is a detachment that calls its loneliness freedom.
chiron-in-pisces: The wound is in faith, compassion and the boundary of the self. A collective hurt around being overwhelmed, abandoned or lost in the suffering of others comes forward, with the escape into substances and fantasy that follows, and the remedy is found in a compassion that includes the self and in surrender practised rather than suffered. Grace heals. The shadow is a victimhood that refuses rescue.
